changes: Fix Xray's VPN-mode capture rules breaking the LAN's DNS and TCP after a reboot when the tunnel was not actually running (autostart off, a missing binary, a crash); rules now install only while Xray is really up and listening.
Fix the Messages page showing "could not be refreshed" when an SMS arrives into an otherwise empty inbox; a message still being read from the modem is now shown as arriving, not as a failure.

Fix the APN reconciler forcing a previous SIM's APN onto a different SIM, and stop force-correcting a PDP type the network narrows on its own; only a genuine APN or auth mismatch is corrected, at most once every ten minutes.
Add a "Restart modem" button (Overview > Control) that parks and re-enables the radio for about 10 seconds, for when a settings change such as an APN edit otherwise needs a full power cycle to clear.

Fix the TTL Fix losing its rules after a power cycle or a firewall reload while still reading as enabled, which left no internet until it was toggled off and on by hand; the rules are now reconciled once a minute.
Fix Xray's LAN redirect being left installed when the tunnel is not listening and an interface event runs the restore path, which broke the LAN's TCP while ping kept working.
Fix the Xray version cache never taking effect while the service is stopped, which re-ran the 34 MB binary on every status poll.
Ship the IP option netfilter targets in the image (iptables-mod-ipopt, kmod-hh71vm-ipt-ipopt, about 18 KB), so a hand-written `iptables -j TTL --ttl-set` rule works without installing anything first.
